fact: Sudan's Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation and Communications launched phase one of a hospital management system programme at Al-Nao Hospital in Khartoum State and the diagnostic centre of Gedaref Hospital, a system the report says comprises integrated applications for civil registration and vital statistics, electronic patient record, laboratory, pharmacy, HMIS, disease surveillance, electronic medical record and health-worker HR information, with gradual expansion to other states planned.
